- [USER] The user is looking for eco-friendly alternatives to traditional plastic wrap for food storage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended eco-friendly alternatives include:
  1. Beeswax wraps: A natural, reusable, and biodegradable alternative made from beeswax, jojoba oil, and cotton.
  2. Reusable silicone bags: Made from food-grade silicone, flexible, airtight, and dishwasher safe.
  3. Glass containers: Non-porous, easy to clean, and can be used for hot or cold foods.
  4. Stainless steel containers: Durable and non-toxic, suitable for storing dry goods and leftovers.
  5. Mason jars: Versatile for canning and storing dry goods or liquids.
  6. Parchment paper or baking paper: Biodegradable and compostable, suitable for wrapping portions.
  7. Cotton or linen cloths: Breathable, natural cloths that can be washed and reused.
  8. Silicone-coated parchment paper: Reusable and easy to clean.
  9. Vegan wax wraps: Made from plant-based waxes for vegans.
  10. Reusable food pouches: Made from BPA-free materials for snacks and sandwiches.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] When shopping for eco-friendly alternatives, look for products that are made from sustainable materials, reusable and durable, non-toxic and BPA-free, biodegradable or compostable, and produced with minimal waste and packaging.
